rifornimenti.name: Supplies
rifornimenti.desc: +40 troops at the start of a campaign

segnale.name: Signal
segnale.lore: The anomalies are not craters: they are Fragments of the Winged. They emit the same signal recorded on the night of the Fall, at regular intervals. Like a heartbeat.

frammenti.name: The Lumen
frammenti.lore: The Lumen, the cold light of the Fragments, drives engines, radios and weapons. Whoever handles it too long stops feeling the cold. Then stops feeling at all.

prototipo.name: Prototype
prototipo.lore: Project Annunciation united the four powers. During the Concord they searched for a voice in the sky. They found it, and they answered.

caduta.name: Technology of the Fall
caduta.lore: The Fall was not a punishment: it was a Trial. The signal is a countdown to the Advent. When the sky opens again, only those who hold the world will count.
